_meta.source: design/kino/raw/colors.json and design/kino/raw/type.json (Figma file YWV3qqUmg6HRNb2UINk7wt, nodes 89:261 and 89:276)
_meta.shape: Same semantic keys as design/atomize/design.json themes (ink, surface, outline, tone, shadow). Radii, spacing and control sizes are not changed.
_meta.appearance: Kino is dark only. No light values were found, so there is no kino-light theme.
_meta.unverifiedMeaning: Keys with no clear Kino source. Each value is the closest Kino colour, or a derived or fallback value, as listed.

type._note: Kino style names keyed to [size, lineHeight, weight]. Weights are Figma names. Bold and ExtraBold have no match in our WEIGHT set and are mapped to semibold below.

footnote.diff: -1 pt, Label / M (13, Medium) also fits

headline.diff: -1 pt, weight SemiBold mapped to semibold

title3.diff: No Kino style at 20. Closest is Title / L (17), 3 pt off. Kino has no 20 role.

title2.diff: exact size and line height, Bold mapped to semibold

display.diff: No Kino style at 24. Closest is Display / L (28), 4 pt off.

title1.diff: exact size and line height, Bold mapped to semibold

outsideCurrentScale._note: Kino sizes with no role in our TYPE set. Not added here; the ground rules are closed.
outsideCurrentScale.tracking: Kino display styles use negative tracking (-4.5% to -1%). We have no tracking token.

scale._note: Kino's own sizes per role, decided 2026-10-11 (new size set for this design system; SF Pro stays; weights stay regular/medium/semibold). The DSL keeps the role names; the theme sets --ds-type-<role>-size/line. title3 takes Score / List (prices in cards); display is the largest role here (Display / XL). display moved to Display / Greeting 56/56 (2026-10-11) for hero scores (consensus card anchor).

unverified.reason: Kino has no tertiary text colour. Used text/secondary, which is the closest Kino colour.
Kino has no text-on-accent token. Used text/primary, the closest light text colour.
Kino has no brand text colour. Used signal/you, which is the only bright accent. It is a signal colour, not a brand one.
No glass token in Kino. Derived from bg/surface at 72% alpha, the same alpha Atomize dark uses.
Kino's Fill swatch is labelled bg/fill but renders as bg/disabled. The value is the same either way.
No control surface token in Kino. Used the fill colour.
No soft brand token in Kino. Derived from bg/accent at 12% alpha, the same alpha Atomize uses.
No gradient in Kino. Built from signal/you and bg/accent.
No skeleton token in Kino. Used the fill colour.
No skeleton token in Kino. Used border/subtle.
Kino border/strong, the closest match.
Same value as outline.control, as in Atomize.
Kino has no success colour. Copied Atomize dark values, not Kino values.
Kino has no warning colour. Copied Atomize dark values, not Kino values.
Kino has no info colour. Copied Atomize dark values, not Kino values.
No error token in Kino. Used signal/you, the closest warm alert colour.
Kino text/secondary and bg/disabled, the closest neutral pair.
Kino gives drop shadows as rgba(5,4,3,0.45) and rgba(5,4,3,0.6) plus an inset highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.04). Mapped to low, high and highlight. base and highlightMed are estimated.
signal/unread is not in the variable list, so its colour is taken from the swatch fill (bg/inverse). Not used in the theme.
border/focus is not in the variable list. Its swatch fill uses icon/secondary. Not used in the theme.
